mapper.select: SELECT * FROM logging.pg_page_acs_log WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY log_no DESC

SELECT pal.log_no, m.menu_nm, pal.user_id, u.user_nm, pal.acs_dttm FROM logging.pg_page_acs_log AS pal LEFT JOIN common.pg_user AS u ON pal.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN common.pg_menu AS m ON pal.menu_no = m.menu_no WHERE 1=1
AND m.menu_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
AND pal.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
AND u.user_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
AND ( m.menu_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR pal.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR u.user_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') )
ORDER BY pal.log_no DESC
